pakomak_streams.scope: Packaging streams: green glass; yellow plastic/cans/metal; blue paper/Tetra Pak.

pakomak_faq.scope: Citizens Q18: Tetra Pak in blue; Q20: plastic bags in yellow; Q25: empty plastic/glass packaging; Q26: bulk caps require contact.

pakomak_vending.scope: Reverse vending collects plastic bottles and cans; PET is named. Do not extend this to bags, cartons or chemical containers.

nula_categories.scope: Electrical/electronic equipment and waste batteries. This is not evidence that each collection point accepts every subtype or condition.

nula_pickup.scope: Electronic-waste collection requests via 070236000. Pickup service, not a verified walk-in facility.

profiles.limits: No inference for drinking glasses, ceramics, mirrors, or hazardous contents.
Preserve narrow snapshot capabilities. General yellow-bin policy alone does not prove this specific site accepts bags or trays.
Tetra Pak expansion is scoped to this operator/container profile, not all paper sites. Contaminated/coated ambiguous items require clarification.
Conservative app subset. Require suitable shape/label and machine acceptance; exclude shampoo bottles, bags, food tins, chemicals and crushed items until specifically confirmed.

electronics.message: Contact Nula Otpad to confirm collection of this device; no verified walk-in facility is in the shared snapshot.

batteries.message: Confirm the battery type and condition with the operator. Damaged, swollen or leaking batteries need specific guidance; ordinary battery collection acceptance is not sufficient.

other_specialist.message: No locally verified acceptance evidence yet for this waste type. Do not route to a general-waste site.
